title: TrendPullback Direction and Repeated-Trade Dependence Audit
question: Does the observed pre-entry momentum difference persist within LONG and SHORT separately, and how sensitive is it to repeated symbols and overlapping market periods?

groups.weak: observed MFE < 2.0% and final net return < 0
groups.confirmed_move: observed MFE >= 2.0%; favorable excursion is not realized profit

rules: Use the same observed entries and outcomes and only fully completed pre-entry candles.
Report group counts and momentum distributions separately for LONG and SHORT; do not pool directions to infer entry quality.
If either comparison group is absent within a direction, mark that direction BLOCKED-EVIDENCE rather than extrapolating.

Identify repeated symbols and overlapping entry-time windows; show symbol-level counts and sensitivity of descriptive differences to one-observation-per-symbol and to excluding overlapping windows, without choosing a favorable subset.
Preserve trade-level counterexamples, including confirmed favorable excursion with negative realized outcome.
Do not tune thresholds, invent independence, propose an entry cutoff, or change production code.
Do not assign evidentiary support from any nonzero descriptive difference alone.
